spec.baseline: E0 is all 730 OOF-eligible support-hold events (2017-2024) with identical execution, sizing and risk control. E1 is the 112 frozen selected signals from the same period. Compare on matched continuous calendar exposure.

costs.note: Costs mean 0.25bp commission plus 0.50bp spread/slippage PER SIDE in the base model. The stress case has 1.00bp spread/slippage PER SIDE with unchanged commission. Native engine commission_rate must be 0.000025 per side and slippage_rate 0.00005 (base) or 0.00010 (stress), not percentages mislabeled as bps. Costs are indicative; historical FTMO bid/ask, depth, swaps and true USD-per-lot commission conversion are unavailable, so approval remains NOT_APPROVED.

evaluation.account: Model one combined multi-pair portfolio. Annualized Sharpe must use continuous daily portfolio equity returns, including zero-position days, not multiplied per-trade returns. Disclose any discrepancy with true FTMO lot/commission/rollover mechanics.
evaluation.daily_flat_sensitivity: Close before 00:00 Europe/Prague reset using available 5m bars; this is a predeclared separate variant, not a fix made after inspecting returns. No swaps for this variant. Continuous 240-bar variants cross overnight and have UNVERIFIED historical swap costs, so their results cannot establish exact prop-firm net profitability.
evaluation.ml4t_engineer_requirement: Independently regenerate and verify the causal EMA50, ATR20, ATR100 and event-time features using installed ml4t.engineer.compute_features. Compare regenerated values/identity against the frozen source panel. Use only prior completed bars and the completed retest 30m bar. The target labels are a custom path-dependent event contract inherited from the frozen diagnostic; do not misrepresent them as a library label.
evaluation.reporting: Each arm: signals, orders, rejects, actual entries/exits, partial fills, close reasons, unclosed positions, USD net PnL, net R after fees, win rate, average win/loss R, daily-equity Sharpe, max DD, worst daily loss (Prague daily reset), per-pair and per-year net results, exposure/risk, loss-barrier breaches, benchmark comparison, and data/engine/config identities. Reconcile engine trades and PnL to reported metrics and record no-trade outcomes as inconclusive.
evaluation.signal_timing: Original 30m event timestamp is the RETEST BAR OPEN t. In 5m bar-open data, the six component bars are stamped t, t+5, t+10, t+15, t+20, t+25 minutes. The t+25 bar contains observed OHLC over [t+25,t+30), so the entire completed 30m event becomes available at t+30. The Strategy.on_data callback for that completed t+25 bar is logically a decision at t+30 despite the open-stamp t+25. Submitting market order using t+25 callback and native NEXT_BAR fills at the immediately next available 5m open t+30, with no future OHLC beyond t+30. DO NOT misinterpret callback bar-open timestamp as the live signal's wall-clock availability time. Test filled_at=t+30 with synthetic data and verify the callback uses only t+25 bar and earlier. Never load future outcome/label columns into the Strategy signal.
evaluation.source_signal: Exact immutable, chronologically out-of-fold LightGBM probabilities from fx_support_conditions_20261008_ml_v2 trial I4_purged_lightgbm_v2, filtered at p>=0.30. The same 730 development events define the unfiltered baseline; 112 previously met the ML gate. Do not retrain/tune/reclassify.
evaluation.stop_condition: Stop if native Engine cannot prove the corrected t+25 completed-bar callback to t+30 NEXT_BAR entry, bracket cancellation, stop-first ties, gap-aware stop prices, and accounting. The prior P0 failure submitted at t+30 callback and filled at t+35; that documented infrastructure attempt is preserved as H0, not erased. The independent synthetic test of the correct final-component alignment (tests/test_fx_support_ml4t_boundary_v2.py) has passed. The economic hypothesis and selection thresholds are unchanged.
evaluation.strategy: LONG ONLY; no averaging, pyramiding or reversing. One position per symbol at a time, maximum 1.0 percent account capital at stop across concurrent open trades. Initial risk 0.50 percent current portfolio equity per new trade, with no increase above frozen signal sizing limits. Account initial cash USD 100000. Quote-PnL uses USD. Round base-currency quantity DOWN to 1000 units (0.01 lot). Gross notional leverage cap 3x portfolio equity, with appropriate conservative margin configuration. Reject entry if next open <= support + 0.00001 or >= target - 0.00001 or if margin/risk gate fails. Entry MARKET at earliest NEXT 5m open after signal. Target LIMIT at reference_high + 0.00001. Hard stop STOP at origin_support (intrabar low, not 30m close). Conservative stop-before-target when both touch one 5m bar; stop gaps cannot fill better than available open, targets never fill above limit without verified favorable price improvement. Cancel sibling on execution. If library lacks reliable OCO/priority or gap behavior, BLOCK rather than invent PnL. Expire after 240 COMPLETE 30m market bars (time exit), one observed timestamp at a time. Do not assume weekend/calendar clock equals observed market bars.
evaluation.terminal_positions: force close before dataset end; never mark open PnL as realized

spec.falsifier: Economic evidence supports this specific variant only if the OOF ML-gated continuous-equity backtest has positive cumulative net PnL, positive mean net realized R, at least 80 completed ML trades, positive performance in at least two of three currency pairs, and net continuous-daily equity Sharpe greater than 0 with maximum drawdown below 6 percent. The net expectancy must improve over the same-calendar development baseline without requiring more gross leverage. The cost-stress run must remain net profitable. The daily-flat variant must be evaluated separately for prop-style feasibility. Missing native stop/order semantics, incomplete trade ledger, or unverifiable costs mean BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS. This development study cannot approve deployment or override the frozen 2025-2026 holdout.

spec.mechanism: A strong origin-support reclaim in aligned momentum and volatility conditions suggests demand has resumed after a retracement. An ML filter may identify favorable target-to-stop paths; a high event-classification precision can nevertheless fail under execution friction, variable payoff ratio, and intrabar support stops.
spec.thesis: The previously frozen out-of-fold LightGBM support-retest gate (p>=0.30) selects trades whose executable net results improve on the same-window unfiltered support-hold strategy when entered no earlier than the next five-minute bar, stopped at origin support, and targeted at the prior significant high. Measure actual net R, portfolio equity and risk.
